title: Hide Take All Screen for LEM
description: Hides the ‘Take Everything’ tutorial hint in Legacy Edition Mini–Games
body:
# ⚠️ Important 

In order for this pack to work, you must download the "Server Pack Unlocker" mod (Fabric)
which will allow you to move this Resource pack above the server's resources in the Resource pack screen.

---

### ✅ With the mod installed
(pack placed above the Server resources)
![With the mod (pack placed above the Server resources)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c87f3cc3541c4eab2f7d1b4cffea2525a2c1f65f.png)

---
---

### ❌ Without the mod installed
(pack cannot be placed over the Server's resources. meaning it won't work.)
![Without the mod (pack cannot be placed over the Server's resources. won't work.)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/673db0beeb33a04caadf4adf9bda476f29821c60.png)
